This follows the previous review’s provisional Hindi/Urdu transmission policy, leaving local Gujarati, Pashto or other intermediaries unresolved; mixed slash responses and metathesized kācū are excluded.

Pothwari cɛrvī and Gujari cɛrbī/cɛrvī retain this consonant sequence with b/v alternation; both members of the selected slash response belong to the same family. The borrowed link preserves the provisional regional Hindi/Urdu route rather than asserting direct Persian contact for each language.

These whole adjectives are linked as regional loans with unresolved local transmission, not as direct descendants of cognate Sanskrit gharma.
